# LocalFlow repository discovery

This file contains prepared metadata for the repository's GitHub About section. Committing it does not change GitHub repository settings automatically.

## Description

```text
Private offline voice typing and local speech-to-text for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Dictate into apps with Whisper, global hotkeys, and optional local AI formatting.
```

## Maintaining the public documentation

Keep [README.md](../README.md) as the English entry point and [README.ru.md](../README.ru.md) as the Russian guide. Update both when supported platforms, installation steps, model defaults, or privacy behavior change. Retain the detailed Russian configuration and troubleshooting reference.

If adding screenshots, capture the actual application and use descriptive alternative text such as “LocalFlow speech-to-text settings on macOS”. Add only supported capabilities and published assets. The repository name stays `voiceAI` so existing clone and release links remain valid.
